'''M'dwello Di''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto]] who was serving a 30 [[Standard year|year]] sentence on [[Tamazall]] for space [[Pirate|piracy]]. The criminal's profile in the [[New Republic]] prison registry was one of several that [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune]] looked at from her office on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]]<ref name="Mando14" /> in [[9 ABY]]<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|14|the appearance of M'dwello Di's profile}}</ref> while searching for the profile of prisoner [[Migs Mayfeld]]. The criminal shared the surname Di<ref name="Mando14" /> with fellow [[Nikto]] [[Ima-Gun Di]], a [[Jedi Master]],<ref name="TCW">{{TCW|Supply Lines}}</ref> and [[Rinnrivin Di]], a [[crime lord]].<ref name="Bloodline">[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
M'dwello Di's profile first appeared in "[[Chapter 14: The Tragedy]],"<ref name="Mando14" /> the sixth episode of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was released on [[December 4]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}}</ref>
